compiler.module_metadata: Per-source module mappings for top-level function facades

features.name: integer_expressions
features.scope: Int arithmetic, bitwise operations, shifts, comparisons, unary operators, and tested Boolean short-circuit expressions.
restrictions: Long scalars have separate AndroidBible ten-feature evidence. No general floating-point arithmetic, unsigned types, operator overloading, or general constant folding.

features.name: functions_and_control_flow
features.scope: Single-file top-level functions with explicit supported signatures, scoped Java extension receivers, Unit bodies/returns, local val/var, block if/else, while, returns, direct calls, Int local += and statement when with Int/Char subjects, ordered comma conditions, single-statement or braced branches, nesting, no-else and empty bodies.
restrictions: Bounded general overload resolution and default/named arguments have separate twenty-addition evidence; function values remain unsupported. This suite tests direct calls and exact-signature object overloads.
if/while/when bodies accept a single statement or a block. Functions must pass the conservative return-path check; when proves a return only with an else and every branch returning.
Compiler resource limits and the nesting limit intentionally reject larger constructs.

Bounded Int when expressions/ranges, for-until loops, loop control, postfix Int locals and definite assignment now have separate Io evidence. Subjectless and String/Boolean when have separate AndroidBible ten-feature evidence. Subject declarations and is/collection/guard conditions and trailing condition commas remain unsupported.

features.name: int_arrays
features.scope: Non-null IntArray parameters/returns, IntArray(size), indexed reads, size, explicit four-argument copyInto, returned destination identity, overlaps, bounds failures and public parameter null checks.
restrictions: Nullable scalars and list construction have separate twenty-addition evidence. This entry claims nonnull primitive-array signatures and the listed array operations; generic arrays and default/named copyInto arguments remain outside its scope.

features.name: jvm_java_interop
features.scope: Java callers compiled against official Kotlin run against Korrust classes; selected JVM signatures match including unchanged AndroidBible IntArrayListUtil extension against the original Java IntArrayList. Directory classpaths, explicit Java imports, declared public instance calls, scoped platform results, void calls and receiver checks are exercised. Bare enum Java callers and generic signatures are also validated against the pinned official compiler. Named/nested object Java callers, reflective constant reads and ConstantValue signatures are validated. Ordinary final classes implement validated imported Kotlin interfaces, including explicit/default JVM methods and constructor String-array fields.
restrictions: Emits class-file versions 49 and 52; requires kotlin-stdlib for non-null reference parameter checks, selected String operations and enum entries.
Kotlin metadata and module mappings cover supported top-level functions and bounded classes; enum/object metadata, source line/local-variable tables and general class forms are absent.
Kotlin consumer evidence covers selected public imports and internal/friend/private/nullability boundaries; full application builds remain unvalidated.

Declared Java statics/fields, bounded overloads and selected Kotlin metadata classes have separate twenty-addition evidence. JAR classpaths, Java construction, Java interface/inherited calls, generics, varargs and annotated methods remain unsupported.
Test-only Android Parcel/Parcelable and NonNull stubs provide javac types only; Android parcel behavior and full Java nullability annotation semantics are unvalidated.

features.name: strings
features.scope: Non-null UTF-16 String parameters, returns, locals, escaped ordinary literals, structural equality, String-left concatenation with String/Int/Boolean, length, isEmpty, startsWith, endsWith, removePrefix, substring, compareTo; unchanged AndroidBible internal stripErrorCodePrefix source.
restrictions: Braced templates and nullable reference declarations have separate AndroidBible ten-feature evidence. No backtick-name templates or raw strings; simple ASCII name interpolation is tested here. No String extension declarations, overloads, or general String API support.
Kotlin consumer metadata evidence is limited to tested public imports and internal function visibility; String API breadth and Android runtime behavior remain outside this claim.

features.name: characters_and_char_arrays
features.scope: UTF-16 Char literals, parameters, returns, locals and comparisons; non-null CharArray parameters/returns, identity, size and indexed reads. Every UTF-16 code unit and unchanged AndroidBible startsWithGutterParagraph are exercised against official Kotlin and independent Java assertions.
restrictions: Io evidence adds tested Int/Char conversions, CharArray construction/copyOf/indexed writes and String(CharArray,offset,count). General Char arithmetic, nullable declarations and other APIs remain unsupported.
Non-BMP characters require surrogate code units; a Char literal must contain exactly one UTF-16 code unit.
Scoped Java Char/Byte/array descriptors and bounded Character intrinsics now have separate Io evidence; general character APIs remain unsupported.

features.name: bare_enum_classes
features.scope: One top-level public/default/internal bare enum per file, empty forms and up to 1024 plain entries with optional trailing comma/terminating semicolon; unchanged AndroidBible RibkaEligibility. Java assertions cover names, ordinals, identity, comparison, declaring class, valueOf exceptions, defensive values arrays, stable ordered immutable kotlin-stdlib EnumEntries, generic reflection, EnumSet/EnumMap and serialization identity.
restrictions: No enum constructor parameters, supertypes, custom members, annotated entries/classes, entry arguments/bodies, nested or multiple enums, mixed top-level declarations or private enum visibility.
No Kotlin metadata or module metadata; Kotlin consumers, Kotlin enum expressions/imports, Android/D8 and full application builds remain unvalidated.
kotlin-stdlib is required at runtime for generated getEntries; general class declarations and Kotlin enum API use in source remain outside this milestone.

features.name: objects_and_literal_constants
features.scope: One top-level public/default/internal named object with nested objects, up to depth 16, 256 classes per source and 1024 constants per object. Literal const vals support inferred or matching explicit Int, Boolean, Char and String; unchanged AndroidBible RequestCodes. Java assertions cover singleton identity, private constructor, nested class reflection/flags, reflective field values, signed Int boundaries, escaped UTF-16/NUL/surrogate constants and 1024 constants.
restrictions: Dynamic object methods and inferred private ThreadLocal array fields have separate Io evidence. No general non-const properties or init blocks, supertypes, companion/data objects, general nested classes, annotations, mixed/multiple top-level declarations or private visibility. Member name INSTANCE is explicitly unsupported for constants and nested objects.
Initializers are single literals with an optional sign for Int; no constant expressions/references, Long, other numeric types, nullable types, raw strings or string templates.

Named object/constant metadata and consumers remain unvalidated; companion/anonymous objects inside bounded source interfaces have separate evidence. Kotlin source object/constant imports and references, Android/D8 and full application builds remain outside this evidence.

features.name: owned_output_lifecycle
features.scope: Recompiling an edited source removes its stale owned class files and matches independent clean compilation, including nested object removal/package changes. CLI tests cover failure preservation, ownership conflicts and output-path protections.
restrictions: This is output ownership and cleanup for explicitly recompiled sources; no incremental dependency graph, deleted-source discovery or compilation cache is implemented.
Incremental speed and whole-app edit-to-running behavior are unmeasured.

Compile/preflight errors preserve prior outputs; filesystem errors during publication are not fully transactional. Missing or externally changed owned artifacts are rejected, and each output directory permits one writer.

features.name: ordinary_final_classes_and_string_arrays
features.scope: One public/default/internal final class per source, explicit primary constructor with private val fields, Array<String>, explicit getter properties and instance methods with straight-line supported expressions. Implements validated Kotlin interfaces with exact override identity and JVM descriptors, including default-interface bridges. Unchanged AndroidBible Yes2SingleChapterVerses plus differently named public TextStore with multiple fields/arithmetic are compared against official Kotlin.
restrictions: Data classes have separate ten-addition evidence; mutable/nonproperty/default constructor parameters, omitted constructors and initialized properties have separate twenty-addition evidence. This entry claims final private-val classes only. Open/abstract/generic/nested classes, init blocks and general arrays remain outside scope.

Class member bytecode supports straight-line expressions and return bodies; control-flow/branching members, overloads, inherited Any/Object members, unsupported interface metadata and Java interface implementations fail closed.

This entry tests nonnullable interface signatures/property identity; nullable/List member signatures have separate twenty-addition evidence. Generic declarations and suspend interfaces remain unsupported.

features.name: kotlin_metadata_and_consumers
features.scope: Metadata and per-source package mappings for supported top-level functions and bounded classes. Pinned official Kotlin compiles/runs separate public consumers importing three facades and a public class, and friend consumers accessing internal class/functions. Independent negative consumers enforce internal/private access and nonnull constructor types.
restrictions: Metadata and consumer compatibility is established only for exercised declaration shapes/signatures; enum/constant-object metadata and arbitrary Kotlin API compatibility are unvalidated; bounded dynamic-object metadata has separate Io evidence.
Kotlin module mappings support discovery of emitted top-level facades; no Gradle incremental dependency graph or incremental speed claim is established.

features.name: source_interfaces_companions_and_defaults
features.scope: Public/internal ordinary source interfaces with abstract supported members, straight-line/default bodies, if expressions, Int.toString, simple ASCII name String interpolation, IllegalArgumentException throw; nested inherited interfaces with abstract Float return descriptors. Bounded companion private String-literal arrays and public anonymous implementation values. Unchanged SingleChapterVerses and renamed RecordView validate helpers/default dispatch/null receivers, companion and private-array identity, initialization, exact anonymous exception messages, Float ABI and Kotlin metadata consumers.
restrictions: Interface/companion/anonymous support is bounded to tested declaration and initialization shapes; no general object construction, mutable companion state, named companions, generics or arbitrary initializers.
This entry tests abstract Float interface descriptors. Float literals/data properties/nullable boxes have separate twenty-addition evidence; general Float arithmetic remains unsupported.

This report tests simple ASCII $name templates; braced expressions have separate AndroidBible ten-feature evidence. Escaped identifier names and raw strings remain unsupported. Constant-object/enum metadata and complete Kotlin/Android compatibility remain outside this evidence.
Source interface default bodies with reference parameters are explicitly unsupported; abstract reference-parameter declarations retain separate supported-signature checks.

features.name: bytes_arrays_and_io_control_flow
features.scope: Signed Byte/ByteArray, byte/int/char conversions, mutable primitive array indexing, CharArray construction/copyOf/String conversion, bounded Int ranges/when expressions, for-until/continue/break and tested definite assignment. Generic renamed fixtures validate all signed byte values, UTF-16 writes, receiver/index/value order, eager String-constructor checks, range/when/loop evaluation once and exceptions. Unchanged Utf8Decoder independently checks every Unicode scalar/simple lowercase, malformed/truncated UTF-8, real Bintex length prefixes, buffer growth and concurrency.
restrictions: This establishes the exercised bounded primitive APIs and control flow; generic collections/arrays, reference equality and unrestricted Java/Character APIs remain unsupported.
Runtime correctness is established for tested inputs; Android-device and complete application behavior and incremental speed remain unmeasured.

features.name: dynamic_objects_threadlocal_and_metadata
features.scope: Public/internal ordinary object methods with exact-signature overloads, JvmStatic/Throws/Suppress/private-inline forms and inferred private ThreadLocal noncapturing array-allocation suppliers. Java/Kotlin consumers check JvmStatic annotations, IOException exceptions, generic field signatures, signed primitive descriptors, public/internal/private/non-null metadata, lazy allocation failures, thread-local identity/replacement and concurrent isolation.
restrictions: ThreadLocal suppliers support bounded noncapturing single array allocations; arbitrary lambdas/captures, explicit generic field types, general initialized object fields, internal object method mangling and reference equality remain unsupported.

Korrust uses derived synthetic Supplier classes and access bridges instead of official invokedynamic; source-defined ABI is compared after excluding only exact validated bridges. Synthetic class inventories intentionally differ and all candidate helpers undergo JVM verification/contract assertions.
